title: SigningSetupRecord
description: Record written by bin/setup-signing.sh --apply to <target>/memory/.nyann/signing-setup.json: the repo-local git-config keys it set, each with the ORIGINAL prior value (null = was unset). --undo consumes it to restore the pre-nyann configuration byte-for-byte and removes the file. Priors are preserved across re-applies so undo always returns to the original state, not an intermediate one.

key.description: The git config key (e.g. gpg.format, user.signingkey).

prior.description: Original repo-local value before nyann touched it; null = was unset (undo unsets it again).
